programRef: Cross-cutting UAT-instrument workstream for the world-engine program (ROADMAP-v2 increments all terminate at Max's lab UAT); north star recorded 2026-07-14: a fresh person judges a world in 30s.
designDecisions: RUNS ON L1 IN THE MAIN CHECKOUT, MAIN-SESSION-DRIVEN: lane A owns the lab HTML; per Max's standing 2026-07-11 directive, workflows build features while the MAIN session owns lab UI/UX. This work is iterative with Max in-thread, not workflow-built. The concurrent atmo derive-not-freeze branch keeps its lab-HTML footprint minimal and rebases onto L1 before merge-back.

QUARANTINE + BADGE (Max's ruling): legacy randomly-applied controls move into a collapsed 'Legacy' section; writer-driven controls get a visible provenance mark; deletion only for provably-dead controls (reversible-first). No feature code is deleted in this workstream — GUI reorganization only.

DEFAULTS ARE PER-WORLD-TYPE: a fresh lab load enables the features that matter for judging that preset (water on water worlds; bands/storms/polar on giants). The default set per preset is agreed with Max in-session as the IA lands.

INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE AGREED IN-SESSION: the nav pane shrinks to a small set of logically-ordered top-level groups. Max is the evaluator of the IA at each step (step-at-a-time, his exact words drive grouping); the contract pins the outcome bar, not the folder tree.

TRUSTING-STATE EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE (Max did not pick it as a friction): stale-override/same-preset-reselect gotchas stay as documented lab gotchas unless they block the solo-UAT gate, in which case re-scope.
NO NEW MACHINERY: Max ruled 'decluttered lab is enough' — no one-click UAT panel, no guided mode. Existing preset picker + reroll buttons remain the drive surface.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A fresh lab load is judgment-ready per world type: the features that matter for judging that preset are ON by default (water visible on water worlds; bands/storms/polar enabled on giants) — no manual flag-flipping before judging.

verifyVia.input: Fresh page load (new context, no persisted state) for each preset in the agreed default table.
verifyVia.observable: The agreed per-preset feature flags read true on _lab.state at load and the corresponding features are visible in the render; no console errors.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Legacy randomly-applied controls live under a collapsed 'Legacy' section and writer-driven controls carry a visible provenance mark — what's the new procgen model vs old legacy features is legible at a glance.

verifyVia.input: Inspect the GUI tree on a fresh load and against the agreed legacy/writer-driven classification list.
verifyVia.observable: Every control on the classification list sits on its ruled side (Legacy folder collapsed by default; writer-driven controls marked); no control is missing.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The navigation pane is no longer 'way too big': top level collapses to the small set of logically-ordered groups agreed with Max, with every retained control reachable under exactly one group.

verifyVia.input: Inspect the GUI tree on a fresh load against the agreed IA.
verifyVia.observable: Top-level group count and order match the agreed IA; no orphaned or duplicated controls; Legacy collapsed.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Reorganization breaks nothing: every retained control still drives its state and render exactly as before the move; the _lab API surface used by verification drives is unchanged.

verifyVia.input: Spot-drive a sample of moved controls from each group (state writes + GUI interaction) and run the existing suites from the repo dir.
verifyVia.observable: Controls change _lab.state and the render as before; suites at their pre-existing baseline; console clean.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Max's gate: he runs a UAT completely solo — picks a preset, re-rolls, finds the controls he needs, and judges the world — without Claude driving and without asking where anything is.

verifyVia.input: Max sits down at the decluttered lab alone (first real use: the atmo derive-not-freeze UAT).
verifyVia.observable: Max's holistic acceptance that the lab is navigable and judgment-ready solo.
